en.title: 3 of 9 resorts in Serbia have snow on top: the list
en.description: 3 of 9 resorts in Serbia have snow on top: the list. Snow cover, new snow, resorts and the days ahead in Serbia on 16 November.
en.lede: 3 of the 9 resorts in Serbia have snow on their upper slopes today. Avantura park leads with 28 cm.

p: Snow on the upper slopes is not the same as open runs: lifts open when the base is deep enough to groom, and the resort decides that.
In Serbia, about 70 km² of high ground is white today, little changed from yesterday.

sections.h: The resorts with the most snow
p: At the top of the list, Avantura park reports 28 cm.
Then come Tornik (25 cm) and Ски центар Копаоник (20 cm).
At Avantura park: 2 cm of fresh snow over three days, 0 cm more expected by Thursday 19 November.
Tornik picked up 2 cm in the last three days and could add 0 cm by Thursday 19 November.
Snow lies on the upper slopes of 3 out of 9 resorts in Serbia.
The rest of the shortlist: Ски центар Копаоник: 20 cm on top, 2 cm in three days, 0 cm expected.
Over the next three days up to 0 cm is expected, and up to 8 cm over the week.
The snowiest day looks like Monday 23 November, with up to 6 cm in the snowiest spots.
The second week adds up to 10 cm where it snows most.
Little has changed on the ground, so the snow you find today is mostly the snow of the last storm.

sections.h: How much of the country is white
p: That is close to the 90 km² of a week ago. No height band is mostly white yet.
Three-day totals peak at 3 cm, around Kopaonik, Zlatibor and Stara Planina.

For comparison, the neighbours on the same day: Bosnia and Herzegovina: 2 % white, deepest Skijalište Kozara with 24 cm, up to 15 cm in the week ahead; Bulgaria: 2 % white, deepest Borovets with 5 cm, up to 9 cm in the week ahead.

advice: Read the local avalanche bulletin before going off-piste.
Early-season snow is thin over rocks: ski the groomed runs first.
Roads to the higher resorts may need winter tyres or chains.

sr.title: Snežni uslovi u Srbiji, 16. novembra 2026.: ski-centri, novi sneg i naredni dani
sr.description: Sneg u Srbiji 16. novembra: snežni pokrivač, novi sneg, visina po nadmorskoj visini, naredni dani i najbolji ski-centri.
sr.lede: U Srbiji je danas pod snegom oko 70 km² (ponedeljak, 16. novembra). Površina je gotovo ista kao jučer.

p: To je blizu 90 km² od pre sedam dana. Nijedan visinski pojas još nije pretežno bel.
Trodnevne količine dostižu 3 cm. Najviše: Kopaonik, Zlatibor i Stara planina.
Prednjači Avantura park: 28 cm na gornjem delu staza.
Slede: Tornik (25 cm) i Ски центар Копаоник (20 cm).
Tornik: 2 cm novog snega za tri dana i do datuma četvrtak, 19. novembra još do 0 cm.
Malo promena: uređene staze su pouzdane, a sneg izvan njih stari i stvrdnjava se.
Prognoza novog snega: do 0 cm za tri dana i do 8 cm za sedam dana.
Najsnežniji dan: ponedeljak, 23. novembra, do 6 cm.
Kasnije, u danima 8–14, na najsnežnijim padinama može pasti još do 10 cm.

advice: Iznad granice šume vetar može naneti sneg: oprezno na grebenima.
